extraction.name: Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation
extraction.description: We introduce Video-As-Prompt (VAP), a new paradigm that reframes semantic-controlled video generation as in-context generation. VAP leverages a reference video as a direct semantic prompt, guiding a frozen Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) via a plug-and-play Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) expert. To power this approach, we built VAP-Data, the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.citeAs: Bian, Y., Chen, X., Li, Z., Zhi, T., Sang, S., Luo, L., & Xu, Q. (2025). Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2510.20888.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We collect 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. We then use Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet; paired videos generated using commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are resized to 480×720 (832) and sampled at 49 frames at 16fps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset includes 100 semantic conditions across 4 categories: concept, style, motion, and camera. Annotations are derived from commercial model API definitions and community LoRA definitions.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates.
